The '''Jedi Temple Main House''' was a dining establishment located in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The establishment catered various dishes to those in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], one such person being [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who disdained the bizarre menu the establishment offered.

==History==
Close to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Obi-Wan Kenobi visited his friend [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] for information on the origin of a [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|saberdart]]. Prior to this event, Obi Wan rekindled his friendship with the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] and began to eat at his restaurant, [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], which served home-cooked [[Foodstuff/Legends|meals]], an alternative to the exotic dishes at the Jedi Temple Main House.

==Menu==
On the culturally-flooded world of Coruscant, restaurants often served unidentifiable and outlandish meals, with the Jedi Temple Main House being no exception. One such meal served was [[Vercupti of sgazza boleruueé/Legends|Vercupti of sgazza boleruueé]], a dish made of [[Insect/Legends|insect]] meat among other ingredients.
